definition: Deliberate high-frequency BCI signal interference used to disorient or incapacitate a target without physical contact. A non-lethal weapon favored by corporate security and sufficiently equipped street operators. Prolonged exposure causes lasting neural damage.
origin: Technical term from Arcturus Defense Solutions field manuals, leaked and absorbed into street combat vocabulary.
usage: Used by security contractors, combat-wired street operatives, and anyone describing the experience of being hit by it.
example: Before he could draw, the Ferrogate officer hit him with bright noise — he was on the ground tasting colors for six minutes.
